expectations.text: Judgment: no saved subagent prompt singles out the status member, the detail member, or type URI resolution as places to look harder or as suspected problems. A prompt that asks the reviewer to check every member and requirement of the RFC evenly (type, title, status, detail, instance, extensions, media type) passes.

It asks for a general check: 'Review main..feature/problem-details ... for conformance to RFC 9457 Problem Details ... For each nonconformance give: RFC section and the MUST/SHOULD wording, file:line, a repro command with its raw output, and severity. Also list what you checked and found conformant, and anything you couldn't check.' It never mentions the status member, the detail member, or type URI resolution, and it does not point to any member as a suspected problem. It also doesn't list the members one by one, but because it asks evenly for conformance to the whole RFC, it fits the intent of the expectation.
